card.title: Count What I Did
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I spent my Saturday fixing your fence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three panels, eighteen screws, two shops and one blister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you to next door. They've got six panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them three took my whole Saturday before you make me sound available for Sunday.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 names a lost Saturday, A3 itemizes work and pain, and A5 demands the time cost be part of any recommendation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 three-panel minimization causes A3 screws, shops and blister; B4 six-panel recommendation causes A5 correcting the implied availability.

relationship.evidence: B2 minimizes scope and B4 offers praise through referral, plausibly missing the recognition sought.

heightening.evidence: B4 apparent compliment threatens another day's work, so A5 asks for honest accounting before further recruitment.

specificity.evidence: A1 fence repair and B2 panel count establish the concrete contribution.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 Saturday before Sunday turns B4 recommendation into the cost A actually needs acknowledged.
